item.title: Just A Sine Wave - Walking In The Woods Bigfoot T-Shirt
item.description: A literal description of how this mathematical cryptid was created! Plotted using Fourier Transform epicycles on a custom-designed application, this green-to-purple gradient Bigfoot is mathematically composed of individual sine waves plotted in 2D space. Perfect for math teachers, sound engineers, physicists, and trigonometry students.

item.title: Fourier Transform Tyrannosaurus Rex - Math Dinosaur T-Shirt
item.description: This design was created using a custom-coded application programmed to trace the Tyrannosaurus Rex outline using Fourier transform math. Rather than a standard text-to-image AI generation, this piece features authentic mathematical plotting, with the body details filled in using the actual FFT equations from the process.

item.title: Fourier Transform Bigfoot - Mathematical Wireframe Art T-Shirt

This striking blue-to-magenta wireframe combines precise scientific calculations with a neon, retro-futuristic synthwave aesthetic. Perfect for engineers, mathematicians, and fans of geometric vector design.

item.title: Leaving No Footprints - Only Frequency Signatures T-Shirt
item.description: In the mathematical universe, Bigfoot leaves no physical tracks, only a distinct frequency signature. Plotted on a custom-designed application using Fourier Transform epicycles, this royal blue and purple wireframe design is made for electrical engineers, RF specialists, and signal processing professionals.

item.title: Generative FFT Bigfoot - Fourier Transform Math Art (Cyan Teal Edition) T-Shirt
item.description: Authentic algorithmic art. This Bigfoot silhouette was drawn by a custom-coded software application using real Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) mathematics and epicyclic plotting. This clean, technical blueprint-style design is the Cyan Teal edition, part of our exclusive 8-color generative math cryptid series. An ideal gift for computer scientists, mathematicians, creative coders, and engineers.
